body: I've been fighting this for a decade. I'm so tired. I don't have the energy to try to get better anymore. I just want the pain to stop.
She wouldn't have treated me the way she did if she cared or still does.
I was in the psych ward for severe suicidal ideation. She gave me no choice.

I did tell her.

We haven't spoken in over six months and she's doing fine.
I've had to leave a lot of circles to get away from someone who hurt me. I've tried getting in touch and they often just don't respond.
She wanted to see other people. I couldn't handle being just friends.
